*October 22, 2026*


Following the recent disclosure of PHP remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, we want to share an update with our customers and website visitors.


## Core services were not exposed


testRigor does not use PHP in its core services. As a result, those services were not exposed to these PHP vulnerabilities.


## Marketing website mitigations implemented


On October 21, 2026, we implemented mitigations on our marketing websites to address the reported vulnerabilities and protect our visitors.


Protecting our customers and website visitors remains a priority. We are committed to responding promptly to security issues and communicating clearly about the steps we take.


Thank you for your continued trust in testRigor.
